# Embedded node_exporter

Tolato-agent embeds collectors from [prometheus/node_exporter](https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter) v1.12.1, Copyright The Prometheus Authors, under Apache License 2.0 (the same license provided in the repository's root `LICENSE`). Its upstream NOTICE is retained here. The module version and transitive dependencies are pinned in `agent/go.mod` and `agent/go.sum`.
